dependencies: Root working transcription must be reconciled against the independent native collation before freezing.
A conceptual source tree is a meaning hypothesis; its operators are not historically attested Voynich units.
TOPIC denotes the implicit philosophical subject, without identifying a material or merging it with its force.
UPPER and LOWER remain distinct from HEAVEN and EARTH. VIS force remains distinct from FORTITUDO strength.
ONE, THIS_ONE_THING and TOPIC require an explicit reference policy; no identity is learned from the target.
All arguments, including inferred grammatical subjects, are explicitly represented here; there is no zero-argument deletion rule.
Source uncertainties at have-glory, causal/relative connection, source-AS constructions and thelesmi remain open in this draft.
Every whole tree and shared root must fit jointly. No source clause is an unconstrained phrase card.

clauses.content: The philosopher says the following text.
The statement is true, without falsehood, certain and most true.
What is above is like what is below, and what is below is like what is above, toward penetrating the wonders of one thing.
As all things were from one through the mediation of one.
And as all things were born from this one thing through adaptation.
Its father is the Sun; its mother is the Moon.
The wind carried it in its own belly.
Its nurse is the Earth.
The father of all thelesm of the whole world is here/this.
Its force is complete if it has been turned into earth.
You shall separate earth from fire, the subtle from the dense, gently and with great skill.
It ascends from earth to heaven.
And again it descends into earth.
It receives the force of the upper and lower things.
Thus the unresolved grammatical subject has/will have/had the glory of the whole world.
And therefore all obscurity will flee from you.
This is the strong strength of the strength of the whole world.
Because/which will overcome every subtle thing and penetrate every solid thing.
As/thus therefore the world was created.
From here there will be wondrous adaptations, whose method is here/this.
Therefore I am called Hermes, having three parts of the whole world's wisdom.
What I said about the operation of Sun and Moon is complete.
